header_version: 0.14 (main branch after the v0.14 tag; last commit before the transitions API)
why_this_commit: clay/clay.odin requires Clay__OpenElementWithId, Clay__HashStringWithOffset and Clay__GetParentElementId, which the v0.14 release lacks. Commits from 2025-11-26 (0c8e3005) through 2026-03-30 (3be87f19) share one public API and struct layout that matches the binding and the exported symbol set of clay/windows/clay.lib; later commits add transitions and change the API.
